newsitem.title: GERMANY: BMW says not to issue regulatory statement.
newsitem.headline: BMW says not to issue regulatory statement.

text.p: German luxury carmaker BMW AG said on Tuesday that it would not issue a regulatory news service statement ahead of its news conference in Paris.

The Munich-based carmaker said earlier on Tuesday that it would hold an unexpected briefing at the Paris car show. Germany's Boersen Zeitung said the briefing would involve "an important strategic investment".

Publicly-traded German companies are required to issue a regulatory news service statements or publish an advertisement in a national German newspaper for the release of any market-moving information.
The BMW briefing in Paris is scheduled to start at 1300 local time (1100 GMT).
